FAQ

Straight answers.

Is SEO still worth it now that people use AI?

Yes. AI assistants and AI Overviews draw on the same web that search engines index. Strong SEO is the foundation for being cited in AI answers, and traditional search still drives most website traffic.

What is the difference between SEO, GEO and AEO?

SEO improves your rankings in search engines. Generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) improve how often AI systems mention and cite your brand. We treat them as one program because they rely on the same foundations.

How do you measure AI visibility?

We track a set of prompts your customers actually ask across major AI assistants and record how often your brand is mentioned, cited and recommended versus competitors.

How long until we see results?

Technical fixes can show impact within weeks. Content and authority work typically compounds over three to six months. Your roadmap sets expectations and we report monthly.

Can you guarantee rankings or AI citations?

No one honestly can. We commit to a transparent plan, measurable work each month and reporting tied to leads and revenue.

Do you work with WordPress?

Yes. We work with WordPress and most major platforms, and can implement changes ourselves or alongside your developers.
